It's kind of both, honestly.
There are real developmental leaps around eighteen months, they're walking more, they've got way more words, and they've discovered that they have opinions.
Oh, the opinions.

Okay, overtired and undertired, how do I even tell the difference?
Look at how long it takes him to fall asleep at bedtime.
If he's out in two minutes, he's probably overtired, and if he's singing to the ceiling for forty five minutes, he probably needs a later bedtime or a shorter nap.
